title: Ok but needs more branches
text: Ok but needs more branches. This wasnt what I expected. It is easy to bend and shape the branches but there is one spot that would have made it look better if they added a branch there. It has that open spot and no matter how much you try to hide it by moving the other branches, it just doesnt help. It needs a few more branches to make it look better. But I do like it because I like light up trees and branches. I just had to move it to the right position to hide the open spot, and make it less noticable.

product_metadata.title: Vanthylit Lighted Fall Tree with 24 LED Thanksgiving Decorations Maple Tree Battery Operated Table Lights Autumn Decorations for Home
features: 【Lighted Maple Tree】: Overall height 2FT with 24 led warm white light. A nice indoor tree to brighten up your fall season, become your unique Thanksgiving decorations indoor

【Timing Function】: Updated switch with on/timer/off function on the top of the base. Turn on the timer, the light will be lighted for 6 hours and then turn off automatically for 18 hours, don't worry about forgetting to turn off the lights, free your hands.
【Battery Powered】: Runs on 3AA battery (not included) without outlets or sockets, it doesn't take up a lot of space, can be conveniently decorated indoors, makes a neat night light!
【DIY Branch】: The autumn decor branches sturdy enough to adjust branches into any shape that you like for your decorating needs, and add other lightweight accessories

【Autumn Decorations for Home】: The natural blend of yellow and orange leaves is the perfect holiday decoration, the small nuts hanging on the branches make the light up fall tree full of life. A nice addition to your table or in your window to celebrate Thanksgiving or for fans of the fall season and those who love the changing of leaves. It makes a nice end table, centerpiece, or general decoration for a fall event.
